g3-replication-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md and dispatch a constellation-implementer via run_crew.py --backend external. GOLF-CORRECTION = DOUBLE-CENTERING (subtract BOTH the driver main effect AND the class main effect from each (driver,class) observation; replicate the residual driver x class interaction on the RAW driver_class_observables substrate, NOT pooled cell points). This is a data transform, NOT a fitted interaction term (owner ruling 4 respected). Channel comparison: run replication per class in BOTH channels (utilization=time_deficit_s, energy=deployment_share); the better-replicating channel earns join weight there per the registered decision rule. THREE-ARM synthetic falsifier (extend #665's generative model with a TRUE driver x class INTERACTION term): (a) pure overall-skill -> ~0 corrected agreement; (b) pure shared-class, zero interaction -> ~0 corrected agreement; (c) injected interaction -> recovers its strength.
